approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would take money from the Consolidated Revenue Fund to cover the government's day-to-day running costs.
The funding equals about seven-twelfths of the estimated yearly total for 2025-26, plus new budget measures and some extra spending already approved for the current financial year.
A separate bill covers the remaining five-twelfths, ensuring enough cash for the first five months of the next financial year.
Appropriates money for the ordinary annual services of government.
Provides seven-twelfths of the estimated 2025-26 annual appropriations plus 2025-26 Budget measures.
Includes appropriations for spending in the rest of 2024-25 agreed since the 2024-25 Additional Estimates.
The federal government's ordinary annual services.
